title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available in Google Antigravity for AI Pro
html:
Following all the model launches this month, Google is bringing Gemini 4 Carbon to paid AI Pro subscribers in Antigravity.

Google shared today that it’s “upgrading models across tiers,” starting with how paid AI Pro ($19.99 per month) users “now have access to Carbon” after previously requiring AI Ultra ($99.99/month). Meanwhile, “Hydrogen will be available to all users as promised.”

As part of this announcement, Google is “resetting Gemini quotas for everyone on Antigravity.” This follows another reset on Saturday after the team introduced caching improvements that “increased the amount you can get done in quota by 22%.”

The Orchestrator in Antigravity was also updated with a better interface for choosing the Orchestrator and Executor models. Go to Settings > Models > Orchestrator Settings.

Additionally, Gemini 4 Argon and 3.8 Flash are set to leave Antigravity on November 30. Other recent updates to Google Antigravity include:

  • v2.34.0: Antigravity can now bring over your MCP servers, skills, custom commands, subagents, and instruction files from coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor into a plugin you own. Ask the agent to import your setup to get started.
  • v2.33.0: You can now connect the Antigravity App to a remote 64-bit Linux machine over SSH from the sidebar, the project menu (SSH Host…), or the command palette (Connect to SSH Host…). Antigravity installs its remote server automatically over OpenSSH using your ~/.ssh/config so projects, Git worktrees, agents, and terminals run on the host and keep working even after you close the window.
  • v2.32.2: Side questions (/btw) now open in a dedicated Side Question tab in the side panel where you can ask multi-turn follow-up questions and let the agent read files, search your workspace, and run read-only commands without interrupting the main conversation.
  • v2.32.0: You can now use Dynamic Workflows to orchestrate parallel subagents and multi-step tasks in Python using the Python runtime bundled with the app.

On the design front:

  • v2.34.0: The Antigravity Dock icon now adapts to Dark Mode and tinted icon styles on macOS 26 and later.
  • v2.30.0: The sidebar and title bar now share one background, and your conversation and side panel sit on it as a card with rounded corners, including in split view.
    • Your messages now appear as chat bubbles on the right side of the conversation.
summary: Following all the model launches this month, Google is bringing Gemini 4 Carbon to paid AI Pro subscribers in Antigravity.
